title: Rust cursor pagination
context: Cursor pagination over events sorted by ascending unique id. A cursor is the hex id of the last event on the previous page and the next page starts strictly after it. Page size comes from the client and must be clamped to 1..=100. Cursors come from clients and may be garbage or point past the end; that must yield an error or an empty page, never a panic. Event kinds are case-sensitive.
